## Changes

### Native SDKs 2.10.1 — [WalletAndroid#208](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/pull/208), [WalletIOS#198](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/198)

- **Issuer permission check**: wrap the native iOS and Android 2.10.1 SDKs. In 2.10.0, `finalizeOffers` checked every credential against an issuer's identity permissions whenever the issuer held any identity service category. An issuer that also holds a career category, such as `IdentityIssuer` with `NotaryIssuer` or `Issuer`, could not issue career credentials: they failed with `issuer_requires_identity_permission`. Identity credentials are now checked against the identity permissions and other credentials against the career ones. Issuers with only identity permissions are checked as before.

No change to the React Native API.

## Backward incompatibilities

- None.
